$comment: Triage record of every finding reported across past audit rounds. Injected into the LLM scan prompt so the auditor does not re-report previously resolved items. A baseline entry means: DO NOT re-report this finding unless the code has materially changed — if it has, you must cite the exact changed file:line and explain what regressed. Verdicts: fixed | false-positive | accepted (documented design / platform behavior / admin-trusted config). Maintained by the maintainer after each triage round; keep entries concise and stable (do not rewrite history, append new rounds).

entries.title: cliCommand command injection
entries.detail: cliCommand is allowlisted (first token in npx/npm/node/codex-security, every token matches /^[A-Za-z0-9_@./:=%-]+$/, invalid values fall back to the pinned default) and the CLI engine refuses to run without an explicit sandboxMode (fail-closed).

entries.title: report endpoint path traversal
entries.detail: The report id must EXACTLY equal a scan.reportDir recorded in state.json; then canonicalize + containment (must stay inside <stateDir>/reports) and readFileSafe (symlink-rejecting).

entries.title: CSRF on POST endpoints
entries.detail: sameHost() requires a localhost Host (DNS-rebinding guard) AND, when an Origin is present, the Origin hostname must equal the Host; token required; rate limited.

entries.title: Source code sent to LLM provider without per-scan consent
entries.detail: Documented, user-authorized design (README + panel subtitle); redactSecrets is best-effort; engine:llm is the product.

entries.title: Token exposed as window.__DSH_SECURITY_TOKEN__
entries.detail: Required for the panel to authenticate; reading it needs page-level XSS (platform compromise) and the endpoints still enforce sameHost.

entries.title: Token file XSS via non-hex token
entries.detail: FIXED (756ca8b): loadOrCreateToken now accepts hex-only (/^[a-f0-9]+$/i) and regenerates otherwise; non-hex can no longer be inlined into the page <script>.

entries.title: HTTP /scan path targets (arbitrary harvest)
entries.detail: FIXED (756ca8b): allowPaths:false for both the model tool and the HTTP endpoint; only preset:/package: keys accepted.

entries.title: reportDir write TOCTOU
entries.detail: FIXED (0f96f03): report dirs now carry a random non-guessable suffix, and both engines re-validate containment (isInsideReports) immediately before each write.

entries.title: harvest read symlink race (Windows)
entries.detail: FIXED (0f96f03): readFileSafe rejects a symlinked final component via lstatSync on platforms without O_NOFOLLOW.

entries.title: scan tool schema accepts extra args
entries.detail: FIXED (0f96f03): additionalProperties:false on dsh_security_scan_plugins parameters.

entries.title: report endpoint symlink read
entries.detail: FIXED (0f96f03): report serving uses the same symlink-rejecting readFileSafe.

entries.title: Origin-less requests pass sameHost
entries.detail: By design: local curl/tooling sends no Origin and authenticates with the token; browsers always send Origin on POST (mismatch rejected) and PNA blocks cross-origin localhost fetches.

entries.title: Unbounded request body on /scan /clear
entries.detail: FIXED (0f96f03): 64KB body cap via readBodyBounded.

entries.title: Case-sensitive harvest skip dirs
entries.detail: FIXED (0f96f03): skip dir names are lowercased before matching (NODE_MODULES etc. cannot bypass).

entries.title: status.json exposes reportDir
entries.detail: Token required; reportDir is what the panel needs to open a report; root is omitted.

entries.title: Report contents readable by another plugin via shared token
entries.detail: DSH plugins run as the same OS user with no isolation boundary — a malicious plugin can already read any plugin's source directly; the token lives in the browser page, not the host process. Hardened anyway: /report is now rate limited (28d905b).

entries.title: clearRecords TOCTOU (check vs delete path)
entries.detail: FIXED (28d905b): rmSync now deletes the canonical path (same resolved target the containment check used).

entries.title: Prompt injection via harvested source (</source_code> delimiter)
entries.detail: System prompt declares harvested code as untrusted data; the delimiter is not the weak point the finding claims. Residual LLM-compliance risk is inherent to the feature.

entries.title: stateDir config unvalidated
entries.detail: Admin-trusted config; misconfiguration is operator error, not an attacker path (attacker with config write already owns the host).

entries.title: Bilingual report split breaks when model quotes the marker
entries.detail: FIXED (66a477b): sanitizer protects only the FIRST marker; panel splits on the first marker whose tail is CJK; prompt forbids quoting the marker.

entries.title: clearRecords path traversal via ..
entries.detail: resolvePath() collapses .. before canonicalization; rmSync uses the canonical path; deleting a non-existent path is a no-op.

entries.title: LLM output may contain attacker-influenced markdown links
entries.detail: mdEscape escapes raw HTML first and only https?:// links render; hardened (79a0d50) with an AI-generated warning banner and rel=noopener noreferrer. Residual risk is social engineering, not code execution.

entries.title: CLI engine runs npx (arbitrary package if config overridden)
entries.detail: cliCommand is admin config, allowlisted, version-pinned (0.1.12), and the CLI engine is opt-in; an attacker who can write config already has host control.

entries.title: report id path traversal
entries.detail: id must exactly match a stored reportDir (absolute path string); relative/.. ids cannot match; containment re-checked after canonicalization.

entries.title: workdir/target path confinement bypass
entries.detail: resolveWorkdir and resolveTarget both canonicalize through symlinks and require containment inside the session working directory.

entries.title: npx supply chain
entries.detail: Version pinned (0.1.12), cliCommand is admin config; supply-chain risk is inherent to the CLI engine.

entries.title: scp-style target TOCTOU
entries.detail: Only non-existent local paths are treated as remote fetches; existing paths (incl. symlinks) go through containment. Residual race is low-probability.

entries.title: Numeric parameter validation missing
entries.detail: toBoundedInt/toBoundedNumber enforce documented ranges at runtime.

entries.title: plan-mode prompt hint
entries.detail: DSH platform behavior, not a plugin vulnerability.

entries.title: cliCommand prefix allowlist bypass
entries.detail: Admin config + character-class validation + fallback to pinned default; no shell metacharacters or glob chars accepted.

entries.title: output_dir symlink swap TOCTOU
entries.detail: mkdirSync then re-canonicalize + containment re-check; documented accepted residual race (README).

entries.title: dsh_security_cli flag smuggling
entries.detail: FIXED (79a0d50): the token after a path-taking flag (--output-dir/-o/--scans-dir/--export-dir/--knowledge-base/--scan-prompt-file) now goes through resolveTarget containment.

entries.title: Payload integrity check warns instead of failing closed
entries.detail: FIXED (79a0d50): a tampered bundled payload now disables the plugin (fail-closed) instead of merely logging a warning.

entries.title: scp-style URL leaks path names
entries.detail: resolveTarget probes local existence first; only genuinely non-existent references become remote fetches.
